# SyncAccounts is one object with two arrays at the add boundary

The accepted typedef describes an object with calendars and addressBooks arrays, and #addSyncAccounts accesses those fields. Its @param currently spells SyncAccounts[] even though the code takes one object. The historical 1382 tag was @type instead of @param. For this specific API comment, recommend describing one SyncAccounts object, so a caller does not infer an array-of-objects contract. This is a scoped manual documentation proposal, not a runtime bug or a new lint rule. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Account Hub sync parameter documentation.
